speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start with the mechanism of injury: How severe was the impact during the rear-end collision, and were you wearing a seatbelt?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly how your right leg is currently positioned compared to your left, and is there any numbness or tingling in that leg? Also, have you been able to bear any weight on the right side since the accident?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe right groin pain. I also have Pain in both knees, Right leg is slightly shortened, flexed, adducted, and internally rotated.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip (DDH) with acute fracture and dislocation of the right hip.
